notes.title: Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/bde439cf4386846b3977bbbc742504e02d54d444.gif[/img]

We're happy to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available for Manipulated!

Those who collect the whole Manipulated set can then craft their cards into a special game badge that is displayed on their Steam profile. Additionally, this badge also gives players special bonus items, including emoticons, profile backgrounds, and even coupons.

[h1]Badges:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/a5b6bc628b6d24eda27845b9af36a14d82259944.png[/img]

[h1]Backgrounds:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/7dfe0006bb48c09d9300a91e9abdbe949b4d7763.png[/img]

[h1]Emoticons:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/95209f0898f8048e0581e3643014dcf046533e68.png[/img]

Happy collecting!


More information about Steam Trading Cards:
[url=steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/]Steam Trading Cards page[/url]
[url=steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq/]FAQ[/url]
